title: Phase 2.1b — HELIX P2 Fixes: Production Docker, mobile assets, CHANGELOG
spec:
PHASE 2.1b: HELIX-HARDEN — P2 fixes

Apply the medium-priority production-readiness fixes identified in TASK-012 audit.

LOCATION: platforms/serviceflow-sdm/

---

FIX 1 (P2): Production Dockerfiles
- Current: Both backend and frontend Dockerfiles use `CMD npm run dev` (development mode)
- Required: Add multi-stage builds for production
- Backend Dockerfile:
  - Stage 1 (builder): `npm ci`, `npm run build`
  - Stage 2 (runtime): Copy built `dist/`, `node_modules`, run `npm run start` (not dev)
  - Keep existing `node:20-alpine` base
- Frontend Dockerfile:
  - Stage 1 (builder): `npm ci`, `npm run build`
  - Stage 2 (runtime): Use `nginx:alpine`, copy built `dist/` to `/usr/share/nginx/html`
  - Add nginx.conf for SPA routing (fallback to index.html)
- Update docker-compose.yml:
  - Change backend `env_file: .env.example` to `env_file: .env` (with comment that .env is gitignored)
  - Keep postgres password as `change_me` for dev (add comment: "Change in production")
  - Add comment about running migrations before backend starts

---

FIX 2 (P2): Mobile assets
- Current: `mobile/app.json` references `./assets/icon.png`, `./assets/splash.png`, `./assets/adaptive-icon.png` but `mobile/assets/` is empty
- Required: Either:
  a. Create placeholder assets (1024x1024 icon, 1284x2778 splash with Helix branding), OR
  b. Update `app.json` to remove asset references and use Expo defaults
- Recommendation: Option B is faster — comment out or set to null the icon/splash/adaptiveIcon fields in app.json
- Add a note in mobile/README.md that assets need to be added before production build

---

FIX 3 (P2): Add CHANGELOG.md
- Location: platforms/serviceflow-sdm/CHANGELOG.md (repo root)
- Format: Keep-a-Changelog style
- Content:
  ```markdown
  # Changelog
  
  All notable changes to ServiceFlow SDM / Helix will be documented in this file.
  
  ## [Unreleased]
  
  ### Added (Phase 2.1 — May 2026)
  - JWT secret validation at startup (fail if default in production)
  - Rate limiting on auth endpoints (10/15min) and write endpoints (100/15min)
  - Zod validation on Salesforce case writes and Webex war-room integration
  - Production-ready Docker multi-stage builds
  - Mobile asset configuration cleanup
  
  ### Changed
  - Docker compose now uses .env instead of .env.example
  
  ## [0.1.0] - 2026-05
  
  ### Added
  - Initial platform with Express backend, React frontend, Expo mobile
  - JWT authentication with SSO support
  - PostgreSQL database with migrations
  - Integrations: Salesforce, ServiceNow, Cisco DNA Center, TAC, Smart Licensing
  - HTML mockup hub with 19 views
  - Power BI analytics embedding
  - Docker Compose development environment
  ```

---

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT modify backend/frontend source code (only Dockerfiles, docker-compose.yml, app.json, docs)
- Do NOT change database schema or migrations
- Test Docker builds locally if possible: `docker build -t helix-backend ./backend` and `docker build -t helix-frontend ./frontend`
- If Docker build fails, report the error but don't block on it (CI/CD will catch)

VERIFICATION:
- Verify all three files are created/updated
- Check that app.json is valid JSON after changes
- List all files changed in result
